page_title: ATM 1-1 CEL | Atletico Madrid v Celta Vigo 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+5' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Celta Vigo will take a corner kick.
90+3' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Celta Vigo for a penalty. Play continues.
90+3' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) picks up a yellow card.
90+2' Celta Vigo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Martinez interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Celta Vigo are awarded the free kick.

88' A through ball from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fails to reach Pablo Duran as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Pablo Duran could have got into a promising position.
87' The attendance for today's match is 64211.
86' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
86' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
85' One of the Atl. Madrid players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
82' 1 - 1 Wonderful movement! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) makes a good run to pick up a cross on the edge of the box and sends the ball into the left side of the goal. What a goal!
80' Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) coming on for Giuliano Simeone.
78' Here is a change. Antoine Griezmann is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
78' Substitution. Rodrigo de Paul walks off the pitch and Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
76' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

76' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball goes behind for a corner. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
72' Substitution. Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Williot Swedberg walks off.
71' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
68' 0 - 1 Goal! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jan Oblak into left side of the goal.
68' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
67' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) was probably a bit loose with his words to Juan Martinez, who decides to show him a yellow.
67' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Juan Martinez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

67' It looks like Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Juan Martinez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. That's a penalty to Celta Vigo! They have a good chance to score now.
65' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
65' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez signals a set piece. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.
62' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Fernando Lopez is replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) will replace Javi Galan.
59' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared.
59' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' The possession of the ball – 34:66.
53' Great touch by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
52' A pass from Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by Jan Oblak and the move breaks down.
50' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Juan Martinez ignores the protests.
46' Half-time substitution. Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) will not participate anymore and Iker Losada is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Claudio Giraldez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo). He is replaced by Borja Iglesias.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Martinez starts the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
45+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) makes a good run inside the box to meet a precise cross. He latches on to it and shoots, but the goalkeeper pulls off an excellent save.
42' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes.
39' Koke (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Vicente Guaita comes off his line to gather the ball.
39' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
37' Claudio Giraldez is forced to make a change. Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Oscar Mingueza.
37' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
37' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) serves up a nice cross, but Jan Oblak punches the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.

36' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.

33' Koke (Atl. Madrid) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
31' A yellow card for a tackle by Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo). Juan Martinez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

30' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
29' 9:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
26' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Martinez saw the whole situation. Atl. Madrid have a free kick.
23' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Koke (Atl. Madrid), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
19' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.
17' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Celta Vigo force their opponents to concede a corner.
16' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
14' Juan Martinez blows his whistle after Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. That's a free kick to Atl. Madrid.
12' The game is interrupted now, Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
10' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Koke (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch for Samuel Lino.

9' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
7' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) has to leave the pitch!

6' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid), but referee Juan Martinez must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
5' Juan Martinez rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid).
2' Neat passing move from Celta Vigo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Juan Martinez.
